sentences.text: For Respondent: Shri R.R. Baisla, P.P.

Petitioners have filed this petition under Section 439 Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 seeking regular bail in F.I.R.
No.500/2016 registered at Police Station Rajgarh, District Alwar, for offence under Section 420,
272, 273, 120-B Indian Penal Code 1860 and Section 48 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
Present case relates to preparation of adultrated Paneer.
Challan has already been presented in the court and conclusion of trial may take time.
There is nothing on record that the petitioners are involved in any other criminal case.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this petition is allowed.
Petitioners be admitted to bail subject to satisfaction of the Trial Court.

(SABINA)J. Mrg.
